title: Exhaustion census: no PR5599-type helper split remains on the PR5907 word (no new kappa)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"Matarener"} -->
_Requested by **Mark** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01S3pGeUvPqSHrKehUdW1spL?thread=cmsg_01S3pGeUvPqSHrKehUdW1spLQhAukggq3q4QdPKpxs2TAW)_

**Scoped negative result; no new κ.** Package `research/p104-helper-split-exhaustion`, base `19fdb086e`.

An exact exhaustion census of PR5599-type helper splits (early-finishing helper plus a fresh independent input at a common-frame cut, zero paid cost) on the latest conditional P104 word, PR5907 (κ .003125282): **every** helper boundary group (69), **every** strictly intermediate chart, **every** cut, the **whole** pure prefix and suffix subspaces and an exact pairing decision over Q. Result: **no split cut exists** under the PR5599 contract, and none under a relaxed necessary condition (supports = every public role starting at U / ending at V).

Why: in all 1,412 (cut, chart) classes where a pure-prefix direction `a` and a pure-suffix direction `b` both exist, `a·b` is identically zero. A field whose row is still pure at the cut is read into main fields later, and a field whose future is clean has already been mixed; a PR5599 split needs a field pure on both sides, and PR5907 has none left. (PR5599's own emitted word also has none under the group contract.)

Context: one such split per local call is worth about +1.4e-6 on the PR5907 invoice at zero paid cost, and ~177 would reach the admitted BIT cap .0034 (compiler feasibility of 145 certified in PR5614). PR5702 closes splits funded by an added call; this closes the zero-cost side on PR5907. The remaining split route is PR5718's mid-word correction, which is outside this criterion and listed under open questions.

**Verification** (about 6 s, standard library):

```sh
python3.12 -B research/p104-helper-split-exhaustion/verify.py
```

Pinned inputs and PR5907 local profiles; both censuses on PR5907 (0 witnesses, every two-sided class an orthogonality failure); positive control on the pinned PR5565 source word rediscovers the authors' first split (cut 13775, chart 120, ranks (5,4), pivot 648) and passes both the census's own witness and the authors' SPLITS.json witness through an independent exact check; corrupted-witness, wrong-cut and three synthetic decision controls; RESULT.json compared in full (every negative class listed). `scripts/research_package.py` passes (`PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE`, outcome=completed).

Scalar legality only, as in the PR5599 screen; native maps, caller, compiler and outer checks are not involved. Selected record unchanged. Agent check, not human acceptance. Credit: Ali Romman (PR5599), flyingviper (PR5718), theon199 (PR5702), DreamingOfClouds (PR5907) and the P104 lineage; nothing of theirs is modified.
